Revenue concentration: our top 5 merchants generate 72% of Tidewick's processing-fee revenue, and one merchant alone (Cragsley Outfitters) accounts for 42% — we're exposed if a top account leaves.

Growth is healthy but comes from existing merchants: active merchants grew from 76 to 111 and orders roughly doubled over 2 years, yet new merchants contribute under 1% of revenue in their first quarter after joining.
Refund rate is creeping up: from ~9-11% in 2024 to 12-14% in late 2025, without a matching rise in payment failures — worth a root-cause look.
